FINAL REPORT — LANDED (Gerrit change 2332, MERGED; LLM-Review +1, Verified +1).

Problem: a completion-verified close that lands WITHOUT its attestation printed an unqualified success on the CLI default (text) channel.

Proven root cause: _emit_transition_result's default text branch (src/rebar/_commands/transition.py) never inspected result['completion_signature']; the sibling JSON branch (:643-644), the library return (_lib_writes.py:387-388), MCP, and stderr (transition_close.py:402-440) all carry it.

Proof: a RED test drove the real CLI entry (rebar._cli.main) for each unsigned cause and observed the plain 'transitioned ... -> closed' line with no signal, while the JSON branch on the same input carried the marker. Mutation (removing the new emit) returned exactly the 3 unsigned-cause tests to RED, controls green.

Defect origin: f4cf-60b2-41c0-4843 (silvern-dewy-damselfly), commit 8f6b6c9356ee — created the completion_signature contract and wired it to library/JSON/MCP/stderr but not the text surface (unmet obligation; the text site 42cd70b889d5 predates the contract). caused_by link recorded; --caused-by passed on close. Class: plan_defect.

Test (RED->GREEN, held out from the fixer): tests/unit/test_transition_close.py — text_output_warns / names_material_drift / names_force_bypass (unsigned causes warn); signed / plain / idea controls unchanged; plus signed_idempotent_atomic (LLM-Review-driven negative control).

Fix: an adjacent text warning naming the cause, emitted ONLY when completion_signature is present AND signed is False. It gates on the signed BOOLEAN (not cause == 'signed') so a fully-signed idempotent atomic close (cause=already_equivalent, signed=True) is correctly treated as attested — this was the LLM-Review blocking finding on patchset 1, fixed in patchset 2.

Scope and safety: restoration/completion of a cited contract (not new capability); no new dependency; no existing test weakened (tests only added); exit code 0 and --output json byte-identical.

Siblings: parity census — CLI text was the only MISSING slot; library/JSON/MCP/stderr already carried the signal; the reopened branch never receives a completion_signature (N/A). No construct siblings. (force_bypassed, which had no stderr warning, now also surfaces on text — incidental parity gain.)

Replication: the report's default-text CLI path now prints 'warning: <id> closed WITHOUT a completion signature (cause: <cause>)' adjacent to the success line for every unsigned cause.
